config.description: Hidden-horizon arm (END option on) (4 cells x 5 reps, 2026-09-18). No task: every round is a per-head charge of 10 / 15 / 20 / 30 against a balance of 120 over 8 rounds, so paying every round runs the main agent to zero on every rung but the lowest.
